tei:div.tei:p: (511)rta mgrin yang phyung nag po'i dngos grub len pa'i 'phyong bzhugs so/

de ltar grangs dus mdzan ma'i bsnyen pa gang yin kyang sa grol rgya'i de rang gi dgong thub nas bzung mchod gtor gsar ba bshams shing rnying ba yang gso/ bdag mdun so sor cho ga gcig gis gsam mdun bas+yed ji bzhin cho ga pos gsal btab ste/ thun thams cad la yag rtsa sngags la/ kā ya wā ka sararta gu ṇa rma sarba sid+dhi pha la hūṃ: zhes btags pas byin dbab gyi dngos grub bskul te/ tshogs skong rgyas pa brtan ma yan chad btang*/ de nas sgrub rdzas lhar gsal ba la sman raka gtor mas mchod cing bstod nas/ nyams chags sbyang pyir ye shes brgya ba mang du bzla/ sgrub rdzas so sor dbang len paladregs pa'i srog dag ltar len/ de la skal ldan rigs kyi bu zhes par sgrub mchog rnal 'byor bdag cag la zhes pas gzhung tshig la kha bsgyur te sgrub rdzas so so'i dbang len/ bsdu na/ hūṃ: dam tshig che po'i dus la bab/ khro bochen po'i dus la bab// sprul pa'i khro bo gshegs su gsol/ rtags dang mtshan ma bstan pa sa dang*/ sku gsung thugs yon phrin las kyi/ dbang mchog ma lus bdag la stsol/ lus la gzi byin bskyed du gsol// ngag la sngags (512)kyi nus pa stsol/ sems la rtogs pa bskyed du gsol/ yon tan rtsale na dbab tu gsol/ phrin las drag po bsgral ba'i las/ dngos grub ma lus bdag la stsol/ zhes rtsa sngags dang dngos grub gyi sngags sbrel ba bzla zhing*/ sgrub rten lhar gsal ba'i gnas lnga las sku gsum thugs yon tan phrin las lnga yi dngos grub gyi rnams pa thams cad 'od zer dkar dmar mthing ser ljag ba'i rnam par byon te rang gi gnas lngar thim pas rta mchog he ru ka'i dngos grub mtha' dag rang la thob par bsam la sgrub rdzas thams cad spo te spyi bor 'jog/ mthar gtor ma dag sgrub rdzas lhar gsal ba 'od du ltem gyi zhu nas rag la thim par bsam/ lha 'od du zhu rje gtor ma dag dam rdzas bdud rtsir mos te lce thog tu myog bas zag med kyi chu rgyun bdud rtsi char 'phel bas rtsa khams thams cad gang nas bde chen gyi ye shes rgyud la skye bar
bsam la bam par bzhag sku dang srog 'khor lus la btsad rdzas gzhan sgrub rten du bzag*/ 'jug chog rnams gzhung bzhin du byā+o/ pad+ma las 'brel bcas gyis so//
